title: AntiAd
description: This mod removing messages from chat, what contains a words from config.
body:
## AntiAd for filtering chat messages.
All config files are in ``` config/antiad-filters.txt ```
**Every stroke is a filter.**
If in your stoke has "Advertisement of" mod been searching for "Advertisement of" and "advertisement of" and other lowercase and others.
Mod is not have support of ModMenu, its been in newer versions of mod. ~~All questions and bug reports send to Telegram @Zver4242_bot ~~
